question.en: Compare closed sediment compositions across three environments.
question.zh: 我们在比较河口、沙丘和黄土的颗粒组成。三部分质量占比相加为100%，希望看到不同来源的混合模式，不能拿三根独立柱子讲完。请说明三元图怎么读，别编地质分类。

why.en: Closed barycentric coordinates preserve all three parts and their 100% constraint.
why.zh: 三元坐标保留三部分的闭合关系；分组切换只过滤点，不改变尺度。

boundary.en: No geological classifications or independent causal interpretation.
boundary.zh: 未推断土壤分类；闭合组成不能当成三个独立原因。

summary.en: All: 36 closed compositions. All coordinates use the same triangle.
summary.zh: All：36个闭合组成，坐标尺度不变。

summary.en: Estuary: 12 closed compositions. All coordinates use the same triangle.
summary.zh: Estuary：12个闭合组成，坐标尺度不变。

summary.en: Dune: 12 closed compositions. All coordinates use the same triangle.
summary.zh: Dune：12个闭合组成，坐标尺度不变。

summary.en: Loess: 12 closed compositions. All coordinates use the same triangle.
summary.zh: Loess：12个闭合组成，坐标尺度不变。

question.en: Where does wind arrive from, and where are the faster observations?
question.zh: 港口观察站有8个来风方向和三个速度档的观测次数。想看风从哪里来、强风集中在哪里。请做极坐标表达，交代角度约定、频率分母和面积编码。

why.en: Equal-angle sectors encode count by area; nested rings separate speed bins.
why.zh: 等角扇区以面积表示次数，环带区分速度档，半径按次数平方根映射。

boundary.en: Only non-calm observations; direction is FROM, clockwise from north.
boundary.zh: 只含非静风观测；方向为来向，由北顺时针；分母为240。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Inspect recurring scalar states while changing a distance threshold.
question.zh: 这个归一化信号似乎重复又有轻微漂移。请做时间×时间的递归图，能切换阈值，并说明递归率怎么算。不要据这张图宣称发现混沌。

why.en: Time-by-time proximity reveals repeated states; a fixed scale makes thresholds comparable.
why.zh: 时间×时间矩阵保留相近状态；阈值切换时数据尺度不变。

boundary.en: Embedding dimension 1. Threshold-dependent texture does not establish chaos.
boundary.zh: 嵌入维度为1；纹理依赖阈值，不证明混沌或真实机制。

summary.en: epsilon=0.1; off-diagonal recurrence 10.47%; denominator 4032.
summary.zh: epsilon=0.1；非对角递归率10.47%；分母4032。

summary.en: epsilon=0.25; off-diagonal recurrence 24.45%; denominator 4032.
summary.zh: epsilon=0.25；非对角递归率24.45%；分母4032。

summary.en: epsilon=0.45; off-diagonal recurrence 43.25%; denominator 4032.
summary.zh: epsilon=0.45；非对角递归率43.25%；分母4032。

question.en: Trace actual device paths through intake, diagnosis and outcome.
question.zh: 维修中心保存了每台设备从入站类型到诊断再到最终处理的记录。我想看哪些路径走向再用、拆件、回收。请用真实转移汇总，不丢设备，也不要让带宽与人数不一致。

why.en: Each ribbon follows a complete observed path; constant width encodes unique devices.
why.zh: 完整记录汇总为路径，带宽按对象数保持一致，节点和阶段守恒。

boundary.en: Complete records only; observed pathways do not identify causes.
boundary.zh: 仅展示完整记录；路径描述转移，不解释原因。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Compare exact archive-tag intersections and isolate multi-tag objects.
question.zh: 我们的档案有文字、图像、声音和空间四种标签，物件可多选。我要比较精确交集的数量，也想只看至少两个标签的对象。不要画无法读数的四集合韦恩图。

why.en: Bars quantify exclusive membership patterns; the dot matrix shows included and excluded tags.
why.zh: 计数柱与成员矩阵配对，区分精确模式和包含式交集。

boundary.en: Universe contains at least one tag. Filtered object count changes explicitly.
boundary.zh: 总体仅含至少一个标签的对象；筛选后明确更新对象数。

summary.en: 64 unique objects / 15 exact membership patterns.
summary.zh: 64个唯一对象 / 15个精确成员模式。

summary.en: 42 unique objects / 11 exact membership patterns.
summary.zh: 42个唯一对象 / 11个精确成员模式。

question.en: Compare time to unreadability while retaining right-censored specimens.
question.zh: 档案馆在做材料耐久试验。有些样本到结束仍可读，或提前退出。请比较两种环境下的可读寿命，保留删失与风险集，不能把未坏样本当成已坏。

why.en: Event-only steps, censor marks and risk counts keep incomplete follow-up visible.
why.zh: 只在事件时刻下降，删失记号与风险集保留不完整观察。

boundary.en: Independent, non-informative censoring assumed; no causal or long-term extrapolation.
boundary.zh: 假设独立、非信息性删失；未估计置信带，不作因果或远期外推。

summary.en: At last follow-up: Dry 57.75% at 100 cycles; Humid 30.00% at 88 cycles.
summary.zh: 末次观察处：Dry在100周期为57.75%；Humid在88周期为30.00%。

question.en: Show why the same input has different responses during a cycle.
question.zh: 同一个输入值在循环上行和下行时响应不同。请保留采样顺序和方向，不要画成一条普通函数拟合线，说明这只是示意数据。

why.en: Ordered coordinates and directional arrows retain the trajectory rather than averaging it away.
why.zh: 按采样顺序连接，并显示方向；同一输入的多个响应不被平均掉。

boundary.en: Normalized illustration, not a fitted law or evidence of a physical mechanism.
boundary.zh: 归一化示意，不是拟合物理定律，也不识别真实机制。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Compare signed temperature anomalies across many stations in a compact space.
question.zh: 8个站点48天的温度距平，希望很小空间里比较正负变化的阶段。试试 Horizon，但一定讲清折叠了什么、每带多少度，不要只剩漂亮纹理。

why.en: Three common 2°C bands fold amplitude into height and colour while preserving sign.
why.zh: 以共同的2°C带宽折叠幅度，保留正负方向和变化时段。

boundary.en: Blue is negative, amber positive; use raw data for precise values.
boundary.zh: 蓝为负、琥珀为正；压缩增加读数成本，精确值需查数据。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Separate a rising synthetic tone from a fixed-frequency component.
question.zh: 这段合成信号频率随时间升高，还叠加一个固定频率。我想看一张能解释它们的时频图，写清窗口、步长和dB参考，不能当成声源识别。

why.en: A windowed transform exposes when frequencies occur, using one global amplitude reference.
why.zh: 窗口化变换把频率放回时间，使用共同的全局幅度参考。

boundary.en: Relative magnitude dB, not PSD; resolution depends on window and hop.
boundary.zh: 相对幅度dB而非PSD；窗口与步长决定时频分辨率，不识别声源。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Compare turbidity distributions and inspect sensitivity to smoothing bandwidth.
question.zh: 我们想比较六个潮汐阶段浊度分布。山脊图可以，但我想切换平滑程度，看形状是否只是带宽造成。所有组用同一个密度缩放，也保留样本量。

why.en: Shared horizontal and absolute-density scales support cross-group comparison.
why.zh: 共同横轴与绝对密度尺度支持比较；带宽参数显式可见。

boundary.en: Density is not point probability. Smoothing does not change the observations.
boundary.zh: 密度不是点概率；平滑不改变原始观测，也不能证明真实多峰。

summary.en: Bandwidth 2 NTU. Six groups, 24 samples each; fixed absolute density scale.
summary.zh: 带宽2 NTU；6组，每组24个观测；绝对密度缩放固定。

summary.en: Bandwidth 5 NTU. Six groups, 24 samples each; fixed absolute density scale.
summary.zh: 带宽5 NTU；6组，每组24个观测；绝对密度缩放固定。

summary.en: Bandwidth 10 NTU. Six groups, 24 samples each; fixed absolute density scale.
summary.zh: 带宽10 NTU；6组，每组24个观测；绝对密度缩放固定。

question.en: Can highly correlated acoustic methods be treated as interchangeable?
question.zh: 两个声学测量方法在同一批样本上数值相关很高，能否替换？允许差异是±3dB。请看配对差值、偏差和一致性界限，不要用相关系数直接作结论。

why.en: Paired differences against paired means expose bias and spread separately from correlation.
why.zh: 以配对均值对照差值，区分相关、偏差、容许误差与一致性界限。

boundary.en: Descriptive mean ±1.96 sample SD; assumptions not established; tolerance is separate.
boundary.zh: mean±1.96样本SD为描述性界限，假设未建立；±3dB容许误差单独给定。

summary.en: Descriptive bias +2.00 dB; LoA [-2.09, +6.09].

question.en: Compare cohorts with identical means but different individual waiting times.
question.zh: 三个服务组的平均等待时间一样，用户抱怨却不同。请保留每个样本和重复值，看看均值隐藏了什么。点位不能为了漂亮改掉真实等待时间。

why.en: Every exact x value and duplicate stays visible; y displacement only resolves collisions.
why.zh: 保留每个精确横坐标与重复值，只沿纵向避碰。

boundary.en: Synthetic n=12 per cohort; no population inference from these small samples.
boundary.zh: 各组n=12的合成小样本，不据此推断总体。

summary.en: All three means are 15 minutes; medians 15 / 15 / 8; the longest wait is 92.
summary.zh: 三组均值均15分钟；中位数15 / 15 / 8；最长等待92分钟。

question.en: Explain opening revenue, signed contributions and closing revenue.
question.zh: 下周董事会要讲清 Q4 收入为什么变化。请把收入的起点、各项增减和终点放在一张可放进汇报的图里，单位要清楚，别把流失藏起来。

why.en: A waterfall preserves additivity, negative losses and the endpoint.
why.zh: 瀑布表达保留起点、带符号贡献与终点，避免把变动误作构成。

boundary.en: Accounting contributions, not a causal model of the business.
boundary.zh: 会计贡献分解不是经营因果模型；数据为合成。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Did a release improve typical latency while making long waits worse?
question.zh: 我是 SRE，发布后大家说请求变快了，但偶尔卡得更久。我想比较两个版本的延迟分布，尤其是 500ms 以上的请求。给我能检查尾部的图，不要只看平均。

why.en: An empirical step distribution preserves the crossing and tail; quantile labels support quick reading.
why.zh: 经验阶梯分布保留交叉与尾部，分位数摘要降低读数成本。

boundary.en: Independent n=20 samples per version; nearest-rank quantiles; not universal improvement.
boundary.zh: 每版本20个独立请求；nearest-rank分位数，不声称普遍改善。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Find which participants became faster or slower after training.
question.zh: 我负责内部培训，想知道这 12 个人训练后任务完成时间怎么变了，能不能看出谁变慢了。做一张让负责人快速读懂的图，也请帮我措辞总结。

why.en: Individual matched lines preserve direction and the lone slower participant.
why.zh: 连接同一参与者的前后测，保留方向与唯一变慢者。

boundary.en: No control group; observed change is not proof of training causality.
boundary.zh: 无对照组；前后变化不证明培训因果效果。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Why did pooled conversion fall while both source-level rates rose?
question.zh: 我是增长 PM，新版的总体转化看起来下降，但同事说每个来源都更好。请检查这里是否有口径问题，做一个可以切换来源查看、也可以复位的表达；没有数据的来源不要显示成零。

why.en: Pooled and stratified rates share an axis; counts and denominators remain explicit.
why.zh: 共同尺度并列总体与分组率；来源切换同步分子、分母与标题。

boundary.en: Observational composition effects, not causal version effects. Missing source data is not zero.
boundary.zh: 观察性构成差异不是版本因果效果；无数据来源不显示为零。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

summary.en: Partner has no observations. A conversion rate cannot be computed.
summary.zh: Partner无观测，不能计算转化率；不是0%。

question.en: When did a sensor exceed its threshold, and where is sampling coverage absent?
question.zh: 设备值班要看一天温度有没有超过 70°C，哪些时段没有采样。数据时间不整齐，不能把缺的当零。请给可读的时间图，并清楚说明能否算出持续超温时长。

why.en: Actual timestamps and broken segments preserve irregular intervals and missing coverage.
why.zh: 按真实时间定位，并在缺测和长间隙处断开。

boundary.en: Exceeding-sample share is not continuous exceedance duration.
boundary.zh: 超阈样本比例不等于持续超阈时长。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Allocate capacity while comparing demand per resident across regions.
question.zh: 我在安排下月服务人力，同时又想知道哪里需求强度最高。四个地区人口差很多，地图真的有必要吗？请把总需求和每千人需求分开比较。

why.en: Separate aligned axes retain two different measures without an unnecessary map.
why.zh: 分开单位和尺度，共同地区顺序支持对照；地图并非必需。

boundary.en: Per-capita intensity cannot replace total demand in capacity planning.
boundary.zh: 人均强度不能替代总量用于容量规划。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

question.en: Compare experimental effect sizes with their supplied intervals.
question.zh: 我给产品评审讲三个实验版本的转化率差异。已有分析给了 95% 置信区间。请展示效果大小和不确定性，不要只按点估计排冠军，帮我写一个严谨标题。

why.en: Points and intervals preserve magnitude, width and the zero reference.
why.zh: 点和区间保留效应大小、宽度及零参考。

boundary.en: Supplied 95% CIs are not recomputed; containing zero does not prove no effect.
boundary.zh: 输入提供的95%CI未重新估计；含零不等于证明无效。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。

title.en: Let a table do the work.

question.en: Reconcile invoices, due dates, credits and the exact net payable.
question.zh: 帮我核对这几笔应付账款，我要查供应商、单号、到期日和精确金额，并看到净应付合计，含贷项。图表只是可选，我最怕查错数。

why.en: A table prioritizes lookup precision and traceability rather than unnecessary charting.
why.zh: 精确查值与对账优先；保留金额精度、贷项和净合计。

boundary.en: Synthetic records, integer cents; no financial conclusion beyond the supplied ledger.
boundary.zh: 合成记录，以整数分存储金额，不外推到真实财务结论。

summary.en: Synthetic data. Read the work for the question, method and interpretation limits.
summary.zh: 合成数据；打开作品解读查看问题、方法和解释边界。
